name: Late Baroque Towns of the Val di Noto (South-Eastern Sicily)
description: Eight towns in south-eastern Sicily, including Noto, Modica, Ragusa and Catania, were rebuilt after a devastating earthquake in 1693. Architects reimagined them in late Baroque style, with sweeping staircases, ornate church facades and elegant palaces. Walking their streets, you'll see how a whole region was reborn in a single, theatrical architectural vision.
